tools.name: submit_shortlist_enquiry
tools.description: Send one Hire Space enquiry covering every venue on the shortlist. Creates leads, not bookings. Provide the event brief and the user's contact details with confirmSubmit:true to send in one step once the user confirms; otherwise the shortlist opens for the user to review. Nothing is sent until confirmSubmit is true.

date.description: Event date (YYYY-MM-DD); must be in the future.

layout.description: Seating layout, e.g. "Theatre", "Cabaret", "Boardroom". Defaults to Any.

timePreset.description: Time of day. Defaults to full-day.

email.description: The user's email address (a work email is preferred).

jobTitle.description: Job title. Required when using a work (non-free) email.

message.description: A short description of the event or any questions for the venue.

requiresBedrooms.description: Set true if the event needs hotel bedrooms / overnight accommodation.

numberOfRooms.description: Number of hotel rooms needed. Providing this implies the event needs accommodation.

maxDistance.description: Maximum distance of the hotel from the venue.

confirmSubmit.description: Set true ONLY after the user has confirmed they want to send this enquiry. When true and the details are complete, the enquiry is submitted in one step. When false or omitted, the on-page form is opened for the user to complete instead.
